properties.markdownProperty:
**Mandatory** section. It contains the traceability matrices considered appropriate to show the dependencies between the elements of the ERS.
Recommended archetypes: **Traceability matrix**, indicating the classes of the rows and of the columns and the trace types considered (by default, dependencies). Traces are recorded in the *Dependencies* property of each element, which is not shown in its table: the traceability matrix is the way of seeing them in the document.
